prompt: A subscription warehouse joins account snapshots directly to invoices, causing enterprise ARR to multiply when an account changes plan twice in a month. Redesign the analytics layer so account history has explicit slowly-changing semantics, invoice facts retain invoice-line grain, and ARR/churn metric definitions have one governed source. Include migration and rollback checks, identify how historical restatements are handled, and prove that the supplied plan-change cases no longer fan out. Do not drift into application database tuning.

requirements: account snapshot history with two intra-month plan changes and effective timestamps
invoice-line facts with known expected monthly ARR totals
an existing fan-out join that overstates one enterprise account
a downstream compatibility fixture that consumes the current mart column names
paired same-model skill/no-skill execution from the identical starting snapshot
